profile.name: Robert Terán
profile.coachTitle: Engineer, Economist & Integrated Management Systems Specialist
profile.bio: ISO Management Systems Specialist with over 30 years of experience in auditing and strategic consulting. Lead Auditor certified by IBM 2025 and Executive Coach, complementing his technical profile with studies in Psychopedagogy, Occupational Well-being, and Organizational Emotional Intelligence.
profile.quote: I integrate the technical precision of engineering with strategic economic analysis and integrated management systems. We optimize processes, bring teams together, and streamline critical decisions for your profitability.

career.description: Quality and Process Coordinator at Rototech, leading continuous improvement implementation with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.
Quality and Production Manager at D'classe Papeis, implementing automated control systems and Lean methodologies.
Senior Purchasing Analyst at General Motors, managing critical input procurement and supplier development.
